description: Renders a report definition — fetches ONLY its selected widgets, not a fixed set. FREE: every widget is a local Postgres read, no upstream call, so this never spends a paid-provider credit or a live Search Console quota unit. `rank_volatility` and `share_of_voice` read the project's FIRST active rank tracker only; `rank_movers` sums across every active tracker.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

reportDefinitionId.description: Report definition ID. Use list_report_definitions to find it.

name: render_report_definition
